text_block_list.text: Today is the Fan Fest, and Tracen Academy is bustling with activity.
Meanwhile, over on the training track…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship, you've been doing great on "Name That Sound!" You're down to your final three sounds now!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Are you ready? Here comes the next one!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I got this! Gimme your best shot!
Plip…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: That's a cinch! It's a tadpole jumping out of the water!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I can't believe it… That's correct!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You figured that out at warp speed! Incredible! Now, on to the next sound!
Trrrum…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Drip…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Too bad, 'cause I know exactly what that is! It's morning dew on grass!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Unbelievable! Not only was that right, you got it in no time! Just how good are you, Golshi?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hehe! You're gonna have to try harder than that if you want to stump me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bold words! Let's move onto the final sound!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Answer correctly, and the championship belt is yours! Now, ready your ears!
Tock, tock, tock.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hm? Strange…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Look at this, folks! Golshi's got her brows furrowed! Has she finally met her match?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Nah, it's not that…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: It's obviously the sound of a woodblock fish.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: What's bothering me is… its life force.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Its, uh, life force?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Each sound until this point felt so alive. They were filled with vitality.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: …But not that poor fish.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I don't feel a thing from it! It has no life, strength, or passion. There's not even the slightest hint that it's alive!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: It's as empty as the dried-out husk of a dead tree!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey, whoever's working behind the scenes! Yeah, you! Are you just going through the motions back there?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Get with the program, ya slacker! That's a temple woodblock you're sounding, so treat the fish with more respect and put some life into it!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I bet you didn't know, but if struck with enough heart and soul, even a wooden fish can take to the water and swim!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Um, I thought this was a quiz show… What happened?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Did they just decide to change directions with it halfway? What is it now, a play?
This is no act. Gold Ship is genuinely angry, and over the treatment of a woodblock of all things!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I'm so done with this quiz! Shut the whole thing down! Show's over!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Bring that wooden fish over to me right now! I'll show you what raging passion sounds like!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hey! You can't go back there!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: RAAAH! Here comes my fishblock solooo!
Gold Ship holds it proudly and begins striking it so fast, her movements are a blur…
It plays as lively as a taiko drum performance, thanks to her expert strikes.
The ripples of energy flowing from the woodblock is just like that of a fish slipping through the water!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: I-is that Gold Ship?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: I heard she was special, but wow…
I can't tell if the audience is impressed by Gold Ship's performance or simply overwhelmed.
Either way, the atmosphere here is electric!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I'm not done yet! Let's go!
She sets up a whole call and response set with the audience while keeping up her intense show.
Many people comment on how baffled they are by what they're witnessing, but they seem pleased by the show all the same.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Amazing… Gold Ship is awesome!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: So this is what it means to steal the show!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hmmm? That sound… Could it be a wooden fish?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It's being played with such vigor! I feel my virtue rising just by listening to it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Haiya, woiya, hoppity-rag! Whether cedar, fir, or sequoia, whatever you're made of fits like a jigsaw!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: …Hm? Is it just me, or are those some pretty sick beats coming from the stands?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Whoooaaa! Just listen to all this! There's so much excitement in the air!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: All right! You know I've got to join in on my air guitar!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Fukukitaru! Tickezo! You two are the best!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the great vibes! Come on down and rock out with me!
Before long, the sound of the wooden fish, rhythmic chanting, and improv air guitar sound effects echo throughout the track.
And throughout the whole thing, the audience doesn't miss a beat playing their part.
This event eventually goes down in Tracen Academy lore as "The Day the Wooden Fish Rocked Out."
